I'm sorry about the mix-up, that's frustrating when you were expecting a peperomia. Our policies don't cover wrong-item deliveries, so I can't promise a specific fix or timeframe, but I can escalate this to a Support Lead. Please send me your order number (it looks like LF-123456) so I can pass it along.

Pothos isn't pet-safe, though peperomia is. If you have pets, keep the plant out of their reach for now. If a pet or person may have eaten any of it, contact a vet, doctor or poison control first.
